summary: What a Claritiy Voice agent does for "{title}", what you set up, and what to check before going live.

sections.subtitle: Where it fits
paragraphs: Claritiy Voice agents answer inbound calls and place outbound calls on a local +91 number, follow the instructions you write, and pass the results back to your systems. For {titleLower}, the routine part of each call (greeting, questions, confirmations, booking) runs automatically, and calls that need a person are flagged for follow-up.

You choose the agent's language (English, Hindi including Hinglish, Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati or Tamil), its voice, what it may and may not say, and when it should end the call. Each plan includes a set number of call minutes, and calls are billed per started minute.

sections.subtitle: How a call works
paragraphs: Claritiy Voice streams call audio from the phone network to a speech-to-speech AI model, so the agent listens and replies in one step instead of passing audio through separate speech-to-text, language-model and text-to-speech services. Callers can interrupt: the agent stops speaking and listens.

sections.subtitle: Compliance and data protection
paragraphs: Batch campaigns dial only between 9 am and 9 pm IST, skip contacts who have opted out, and keep a record of every call. You confirm that you have consent before each campaign, and you remain responsible for your own TRAI obligations, such as DLT registration and DND (NCPR) scrubbing.

Recording is off by default. If you switch it on for an agent, the caller hears a recording notice first, and recordings are deleted after 90 days at the latest, or sooner if a shorter retention period is set. Personal data in transcripts can be redacted by category for each agent, and data is encrypted in transit. If your industry requires a vendor certified under a standard such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2 or ISO 27001, ask us for our current status before you start, and do not collect card numbers or health records on calls.

sections.subtitle: What to measure
paragraphs: Track these in Call History, Analytics and Reports to judge results for {titleLower}:
bullets: Answer rate and average call duration.
Outcome labels from post-call analysis, for example confirmed, cancelled or callback requested.
Calls flagged for a person to follow up.
Billed minutes against your plan balance.
